funds: Small grants for builders shipping products that are live on Base only. Retroactive and proactive builder rewards for early-stage projects.
name: Base Builder Grants
notes: Season 2 opened 2026-10-27. Project must be live on Base to qualify.

funds: Grant support for independent creators already making content about Base — writers, streamers, podcasters, video creators and educators.
name: Base Creator Grants
notes: Round 2 closed; the application form is paused and Round 3 has not opened yet. Apply to be included in the next cohort when it opens.

funds: Open-source public goods for the Ethereum ecosystem via wishlist and RFP items, plus direct inquiries.
name: Ethereum Foundation ESP (Ecosystem Support Program)
notes: As of 2026-11-22 the ESP lists no open wishlist or RFP items; applications are effectively paused.

funds: Subsidy covering up to 30% of a professional smart contract audit for teams building on Ethereum mainnet, booked through Areta Market (20+ audit firms). Not a cash grant — the subsidy is applied to the audit cost.
name: Ethereum Audit Subsidy Program
notes: Announced 2026-04-14 as part of the EF's Trillion Dollar Security initiative; $1M pool via Areta Market. Rolling application cohorts throughout the year, no deadline. Any mainnet team can apply; CROPS-aligned projects (censorship resistance, open source, privacy, security) get priority. Also called the Ethereum Security Subsidy Program. Apply via Areta Market.

funds: Grants for SDKs, integrations, solver tooling and research that advance CoW Protocol — intent-based trading and batch auctions on Ethereum mainnet. Apply by posting on the CoW forum; the Grants Committee votes on Snapshot over three days.
name: CoW DAO Grants
notes: Open, rolling applications under the 2026 mandate (CIP-82); grants treasury on Ethereum Mainnet. Paid by milestone, monthly after technical review. A steward is assigned to approved grants.

funds: Milestone-based grants up to $50,000 in USDC for novel trading strategies on 1inch's Aqua shared-liquidity layer and new swapVM instructions — dynamic-fee AMMs, oracle-based pricing and market-making, cross-chain or multi-asset strategies, RWA/LST strategies. In exchange, teams share a percentage of the strategy's revenue with the 1inch DAO from the first dollar (team-proposed, committee-reviewed; buyout option after 3 years). Not a no-strings grant — read the revenue-share terms. KYC/KYB required.
name: 1inch Aqua Revenue Stream Incubator
notes: Announced 2026-07-07 by 1inch DAO; $436,000 total pool, 8–10 teams expected. Rolling applications via Notion form; reviewed by StableLab, DAOPlomats and Arana Digital (2-of-3 approval). Aqua runs on Ethereum, Base, Optimism, Arbitrum and Polygon (same contract address). Still active in Nov 2026 — applicants following up on the official forum thread as recently as Nov 20. Novelty is the #1 screen; hackathon teams with a PoC welcome; solo builders accepted with real DeFi/smart-contract experience.

funds: Co-funding for Ethereum security initiatives — compilers, wallets, signing flows, formal verification, incident response, core protocol and L2 security. Propose an initiative as an RFP or grant on the public board; backers pledge, and ETHSecurity Badge holders allocate the fund's remaining budget. Nothing starts until an initiative is fully funded. Not a one-off grant, and it does not pay for your own audits.
name: TheDAO Security Fund
notes: Round Two open Sep 15, 2026 – Jan 31, 2027. Endowment of ~69,000 staked ETH (rewards ~1,800 ETH/year); 134 projects supported with 1000+ ETH so far. Apply by drafting an initiative and submitting at initiatives.thedao.fund/submit; approved initiatives go on the public board for backer pledges. Milestone deliveries are reviewed by a technical reviewer and paid within 14 days of acceptance.

funds: Public goods funding rounds using quadratic funding, matched by sponsors.
name: Gitcoin Grants
notes: No grants round has run since October 2025; the program is between rounds.

funds: Grants for developers and projects building on Unichain (Uniswap's L2).
name: Unichain Grants

funds: Spark grants for builders launching apps and infrastructure on Ink (Kraken's L2).
name: Ink Spark

funds: Milestone-based grants for teams scaling real products on Ink (Kraken's L2) — the flagship track of the Ink Builder Program, for teams with live traction and a clear plan to grow.
name: Ink Forge
notes: Added to the registry 2026-11-27. CLOSED to new applications the same day: the official Forge docs page states 'Forge is no longer accepting applications' and directs teams to Inkworks (ink.works), Ink's new flagship builder program. The track description remains on Ink's docs, but the application route is closed.

funds: Cohort program for frontier builders on Ink (Kraken's L2): 6 weeks of working sessions with the Ink team and mentors, milestone-based funding, and a public launch plus a private VC demo day. 8 teams per cohort; alumni status is permanent.
name: Inkworks
notes: Cohort 01 open with rolling applications (one-page form, no deck needed). Ink's new flagship builder program, replacing Forge as the application route for teams scaling on Ink. Verified on ink.works.

funds: Retroactive rewards for public goods that have already delivered impact on Optimism and the Superchain.
name: Optimism Retro Funding
notes: Paused since January 2026 for at least 12 months; no restart date announced.

funds: Milestone-based grants for open-source public goods and infrastructure on Solana. Included here for completeness.
name: Solana Foundation Grants

funds: Small, fast Instagrants (up to $10,000 in USDG) for Solana builders, paid in tranches against milestones.
name: Superteam Instagrants
notes: All regional listings have shown Applications Paused since about April/May 2026, with no restart date.

funds: Grants for open-source projects building on or benefiting the BNB Chain ecosystem, with a focus on developer tools and infrastructure, DeFi, GameFi, AI/DePIN and decentralized social.
name: BNB Chain Builder Grants
notes: Rolling applications with a two-round review: a relevance and technical check, then a plan presentation where milestones and the grant amount are agreed. Winners are announced every two months.

funds: Connects builders on BNB Chain to tools and services from ecosystem providers — cloud services, security audit and analysis, marketing services, wallets and launchpads — as discounts, credits and in-kind support.
name: BNB Chain Kickstart
notes: Rolling applications; applicants choose which provider offerings to claim and BNB Chain evaluates the project.

funds: Retroactive grants for completed, verifiable work that materially advances a Shutter priority on BNB Chain — currently an encrypted-mempool deployment. Not funding for future plans or generic research.
name: Shutter DAO Impact Pilot
notes: Round 2 opened 2026-11-20. Completed-work and evidence deadline 2026-12-21; awards decided by Shutter DAO vote in January 2027.
